h: The Covenant Preserves Israel Beyond Its Own Merit

p: אַתָּה עוֹבֵר הַיּוֹם אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן וְגוֹמֵר (דְּבָרִים ט, א)
you are crossing the Yarden today," etc. (Devarim 9:1).
for through the holiness of Yisrael,
who are called by that name on account of
"For you have striven with God and with men" (Bereishis 32:29),
they merit the aspect of atah, "you":
that is, that there shine from the root,
which is alef, the supernal wonder,
and tav, which is from the World to Come,
So too the word hayom alludes
that there shine from the upper heh,
and it becomes a closed mem
that it be like an inheritance,
עַל מִדַּת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
the middah of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom:
And opposite this in the kelipah,
under the dominion of the seven nations,
they drew from the nine kavin of wisdom,
And that is why it says "than you":
for this they obtained from the holiness
And this is in the holiness of the soul.
So too there is in the holiness of place:
וְהוּא גַּם כֵּן בְּב׳ מַדְרֵגוֹת אֵלּוּ
and it too is in these two levels:
to bring words of Torah and holiness
into "a wise man's heart, at his right,"
and to overcome the yetzer hara
under the dominion of the nations of the world,
And that is why it says,
"great cities, fortified up to the heavens":
this is in the aspect of place,
corresponding to the two levels in holiness,
and this corresponds to the holiness of Avraham and Yitzchak.
עַם גָּדוֹל וָרָם בְּנֵי עֲנָקִים (שָׁם ט, ב)
"A people great and tall, the children of the giants" (ibid. 9:2)
corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu,
"For Hashem is a sun and a shield."
And opposite this in the kelipah
who "wear the sun as a necklace with their height" (Sotah 34b).
that He will instill Daas in you,
is the One Who crosses before you,
which consumes the fire of the yetzer hara
that is, to rectify all the past,
so that they cannot harm you.
"And He will subdue them before you"
שֶׁלֹּא יוּכַל הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע לִכְנוֹס עוֹד
that the yetzer hara will no longer be able to enter.
that it will not be able to enter,
the yetzer hara, into you in the future.

p: "'Because of my righteousness Hashem brought me
Hashem granted me to possess the land
with the nine kavin of wisdom,
as an inheritance that has no interruption.
"Not because of your righteousness or the uprightness of your heart
are you coming to possess," etc.
the holiness of Eretz Yisrael forever
comes only when one merits uprightness of heart;
and then the upright are for joy,
"And for the upright of heart, joy"
And man, on his own part,
And the inheritance of the land
זָכוּ רַק עַל יְדֵי בְּרִית אָבוֹת
they merited only through the covenant of the Avos,
"and in order to establish the word
that is, there is found in Yisrael
which corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu;
like those listed in the Mishnah (Sanhedrin 10:2)
as having no share in Olam Haba;
Hashem in His kindness will grant them an inheritance
as the expounders of allusions expounded
all who are of the seed of Yaakov,
that one master said one thing
and the other master said another, and they do not disagree:
counted them as having no share,
Hashem Yisbarach will grant it to them in His kindness,
and they come to Olam Haba.
And that is why it says (ibid. 9:13):
"and behold, it is a stiff-necked people":
that is, they blemished at the root,
that is, only from under the heavens;
there the name Yisrael will remain.
the holiness of the Avos, which is called Yisrael.
into a nation mightier and greater than it":
will include the holiness of Avraham and Yitzchak:
the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,
the holiness of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom
and that is why it says "than it";
will flow the words of Torah into them.
And that is why it says (ibid. 9:17):
and cast them from upon my two hands":
that is, in his grasping the Tablets
which is the sum of the holiness of Avraham and Yitzchak,
"and I broke them before your eyes":
that is, to bring into the heart of Yisrael
עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה כח, ב)
along the lines of what they said (Avodah Zarah 28b):
depend on the understanding of the heart."
And this is alluded to in what it says,
that it will flow into their hearts from the root,
and it will be closed in forever,
that is, even though they are called am, "people,"
for the light is dim in them.
And he mentioned the merit of the Avos (ibid. 9:27):
אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה
"Do not turn to the stubbornness of this people,
nor to its wickedness, nor to its sin";
and this corresponds to the holiness of the three Avos.
as we said on what it says,
that is, a sin at the root;
and this corresponds to the holiness of
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
who brought down words of Torah
when he transgresses the words of Torah.
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,
שֶׁמּוֹפִיעַ עַל יְדֵי מִדַּת פַּחַד יִצְחָק
which shines through the middah of the Fear of Yitzchak,
and even when one does teshuvah out of fear,
willful sins become like unintentional ones;
and that is why it says "nor to its sin."
"And they are Your people and Your inheritance" (ibid. 9:29)
corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu,
"Yaakov is the lot of His inheritance."
"Whom You took out with Your great strength"
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
whose middah is the aspect of Gedulah,
and it is the right arm.
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,
